# TSP-040 — hand-written `until … sleep` loops outnumber `wait-for` 3:1; a PreToolUse hook denies the loop and names the `wait-for` line

## Problem
`wait-for` exists, the guide says "never a hand-written `until …; do sleep …; done` loop", and the interactive orchestrator and its subagents still write 26 of them a day. Each one is unregistered, polls a dead job until the sentinel kills it, and takes a sentinel pass plus a kill line instead of exiting on its own.

## Evidence
- `agents-log --since 7d --grep 'until .*; *do' | wc -l` → 184 on 2026-10-15 (kind interactive 182, bench 2, agent 0); `agents-log --since 7d --grep '(^|[;&| ])wait-for ' | wc -l` → 65 (interactive 49, agent 14, bench 3). Rostered agents comply; the orchestrator session and its subagents do not.
- `agents-log --since 4d --stats`, session `f950f2b2`: `until=139 … wait-for=30 … sleep=26`; session `8f2b563a`: `until=18`, `wait-for=1`.
- `agents-log --since 4d --grep 'until '` — the top shapes are `until grep -q "^exit" <log>` (× 5, 4, 4, 3, 3, 3), `until grep -q "ALL DONE" …/done.txt` (× 5), `until [ -s <log> ] && grep …` — every one is `wait-for --file F --match RE` or `wait-for --until 'COND'`.
- `sentinel/state/sentinel.log` — 14 `stuck-wait killed` lines in total, 3 between 10-12 22:48 and 10-14 13:00, all of them `until …` shells whose owner agent had ended (the outcome the guide predicts).
- `KB/guides/wait-for-and-stuck-loops.md:8` — "Never a hand-written `until …; do sleep …; done` loop: it is unregistered, and if its job dies it polls until the sentinel kills it."
- `adapters/claude/settings.fragment.json` — hooks are `SessionStart`, `PostToolUse` (audit), `SubagentStart/Stop`; no `PreToolUse`. Nothing on the machine can stop a loop before it starts; `sentinel-waits` only judges it 15 min later.

## Survey
- exists: Claude Code `PreToolUse` hooks receive `tool_name` + `tool_input.command` on stdin and may print `hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision: "deny"` with `permissionDecisionReason`, which Claude sees and acts on; exit 2 with stderr blocks the same way; `updatedInput` can rewrite the command (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks, read 2026-10-15; installed Claude Code 2.1.299).
- exists: the deny-with-alternative pattern is the documented way to steer tool choice — deny `echo`, say "use `node -e`" and the agent self-corrects on the next call (https://beta.egghead.io/lessons/guide-claude-code-with-rich-pre-tool-use-feedback~ex177, read 2026-10-15).
- exists locally: `bin/wait-for` (`--pid`, `--file F --match RE [--job PID]`, `--until 'COND'`), `bin/sentinel-waits` (post-hoc judge), `sentinel-runaway` rule 1 (post-hoc kill), `bin/tests/wait-for.test.sh`, `bin/tests/sentinel-waits.test.sh`.
- rejected: `permissions.deny` rule `Bash(until *)` — prefix match misses `cd … && until`, `S=…; until`, and carries no reason, so the agent learns nothing. Rejected: `updatedInput` rewriting the loop into a `wait-for` line — a wrong translation would silently wait on the wrong thing; a deny with the suggested line keeps the agent in charge. Rejected: adding the rule to `AGENTS.md` again — it is already in the guide and the audit shows the text is not read at the moment the loop is written; the hook fires exactly then.
- chosen: one small bash hook, `deny` with the translated `wait-for` line as the reason.

## Proposed change
- New `adapters/claude/hooks/wait-loop-hint.sh` (bash + `grep -E`, no python start-up: it runs on every Bash call, ≈ 3 000/day). Reads stdin JSON, extracts `tool_input.command` (`jq -r`), and when it matches `\b(until|while)\b[^;]*;[[:space:]]*do\b.*\bsleep\b` and does not contain `wait-for `, prints
  `{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Hand-written wait loop (KB/guides/wait-for-and-stuck-loops.md). Use: <line>"}}`
  where `<line>` is `wait-for --file F --match 'RE'` when the condition is `grep -q… RE F`, `wait-for --pid PID` when it is `kill -0 PID` / `! pgrep`, else `wait-for --until '<condition>'`. Everything else: exit 0, no output.
- `adapters/claude/settings.fragment.json`: `PreToolUse` entry, `"matcher": "Bash"`, `"timeout": 5`. `adapters/claude/install` already merges the fragment; the owner reruns it.
- `bin/tests/claude-hooks.test.sh`: feeds JSON fixtures through the script (deny for the 6 shapes above, no output for `wait-for --until`, for a `for` loop, for `until` inside a quoted string); selftest first: the script under test never executes the command (it only reads stdin), proven by a fixture command `touch $WORK/must-not-exist` and an absence check.
- `KB/guides/wait-for-and-stuck-loops.md`: one pitfall line ("the hook denies the loop; the reason is the line to run").

## Success check
`metric / before (number) / target (number) / measured by (command)`

- metric: hand-written wait loops per 7 days, all kinds; stuck-wait kills per 7 days
- before: 184 loops (10-15); 3 kills (10-12 → 10-14)
- target: ≤ 10 loops; 0 kills; `wait-for` count not lower than 65
- measured by: `agents-log --since 7d --grep 'until .*; *do' | wc -l`; `agents-log --since 7d --grep '(^|[;&| ])wait-for ' | wc -l`; `grep -c 'stuck-wait killed' ~/agents/sentinel/state/sentinel.log` (delta over the week)

## Effort
`model / sessions (integer) / resident (CPU/RSS or none)`

- model: sonnet
- sessions: 1
- resident: none (≈ 3 ms bash+grep per Bash tool call)

## Class
owner-go

The hook list in `~/.claude/settings.json` is the owner's file (same class as the audit matcher, TSP-006); the fragment and script take effect only when the owner reruns `adapters/claude/install`.

## Result
Shipped 2026-10-19 by T436 (owner: "go TSP-040"). Status: built and tested, live once the owner runs
`bash ~/agents/adapters/claude/install` (owner-todo 20); measurement pending one week after that.

- Built differently from the proposal: Python, not bash+grep, so the hook reuses the T376 parser
  (`hooks/wait_nudge.py`, new `loop_wait()` + `code_mask()`) instead of a second regex set. Fast path: no
  `sleep` in the command → exit before the import. Latency 34 ms per call (10 runs, subprocess). Loops in
  quoted data (`echo '…'`, `claude -p "…"`, JSON fixtures) and heredoc bodies now pass, for the nudge too.
- Files: `hooks/sleep-loop-block.py` (new), `hooks/sleep-loop-block.test.py` (new), `hooks/wait_nudge.py`,
  `adapters/claude/settings.fragment.json` (PreToolUse Bash, timeout 5; `"async": true` on the audit entry so the
  install keeps the live setting), `KB/guides/wait-for-and-stuck-loops.md` (one pitfall).
- Validation: `python3 hooks/sleep-loop-block.test.py` PASS (selftest: the hook never runs the command; 9 deny
  shapes; 18 pass cases incl. `sleep 1`, `watch`, `wait-for`, for/while-read loops, quoted and heredoc loops; fail
  open). `wait-nudge.test.py` 29 ok, `guards.test.sh` 0 fail, `no-machine-values.test.sh` pass, merge into a copy of
  settings.json adds only PreToolUse. `pc doctor --quick` 17/18 before and after (usage latency under load, not this).
- Replay, 7 days of audit Bash summaries: 15 269 commands, 139 denied, 0 on data (the 5 data hits of the first
  pass fixed by `code_mask`); 3 of the 139 are deliberate reaper fixtures (real loops; the guide says: script file).
- Live probes (headless haiku, `--settings` with only this hook): main thread denied and ran the suggested
  `wait-for` (audit log: the loop never ran); a subagent got the deny with the exact line.
- Before (2026-10-19 08:30): `until …; do` 151 / 7 d; `wait-for` 129 / 7 d; `stuck-wait killed` 14 total;
  share `wait_nudge.py --share 7` 32.4 % (70 vs 146). After: pending, one week after the install.
